corrected_prompt:
Photoreal POV photo, vertical 9:16, 35mm lens, everything sharp. Look: a POV dramatization with hands only and never a face; a warm evening home office lit by a tungsten desk lamp from the upper left, soft shadows, natural skin; the hand always in a mustard-yellow knit sleeve; muted warm palette of walnut, warm grey, mustard and paper white, red only on the price stickers.
Reference images: none attached; this prompt is the only input.
Subject: three identical plain white tall narrow paper sheets lying flat in a row on a desk, seen from straight above, side by side with small gaps, filling the middle band of the frame (x 3% to 97%, y 36% to 80%); each sheet about 30% of the frame width and 44% of the frame height; the set appears once.
Hands: one adult hand, the viewer's own, wrist in a mustard-yellow knit sleeve, entering from the bottom edge at the lower right (x 66% to 96%, y 74% to 100%). Its index finger and thumb pinch the bottom left corner of the right-hand sheet (the corner away from its sticker) and lift that corner about 2 cm off the desk. The hand covers no heading letter and no part of any sticker. Exactly one hand with five fingers; no other hand.
Action: thumb and index finger pinch the right-hand sheet's bottom left corner; the corner lifts 2 cm and the sheet bends slightly; the other two sheets lie flat.
Props: the three sheets are copies, identical in layout, words and type. On each, three headings stacked in heavy black block capitals, each heading on one single line filling about 85% of the sheet's width (letters about 4% of the sheet height), with a few grey lines of unreadable small body text under each heading. Each sheet has one plain round red sticker in its lower right corner with no writing on it: the left sheet's sticker is the largest, the middle one smaller, the right one the smallest. That sticker size is the only difference between the sheets.
Text: on each of the three sheets, the same three headings, top to bottom: "PROGRAM", then "WEEKLY CALLS", then "A PROMISE". Upper case, exactly these words, spelled the same on all three sheets. The body lines under them are grey bars, not readable words. Nothing covers any heading letter.
Setting: a warm walnut desk seen from straight above in the evening; nothing else on the desk.
Camera: flat lay, straight down at 90 degrees, 9:16. The top 32% of the frame is bare dark walnut wood with nothing on it. The bottom 12% holds only the hand and wood.
Continuity: none, this is the first frame of the reel.
Negatives: no face; no logo, brand or app name; no digits, prices or currency signs anywhere, the stickers stay blank; no words other than the three headings; no fourth sheet; no pens, phones or cups on the desk; no second hand.
note: The corrected prompt follows the spec as written except where the spec contradicts itself (A4 vs 30%x44%, 9% heading height, which pinch corner); the spec changes in qa/H-01-V3.spec.json suggested_spec_changes should be made first so spec and prompt agree, then re-run the spec review.
